prompt: 4-bromotoluene + NaNH₂/NH₃ gives a mixture of 3- and 4-aminotoluenes. What does this tell you?

options.label: The reaction goes through a benzyne intermediate; nucleophile adds at either of the two sp carbons.

explanation: The benzyne intermediate from 4-bromotoluene has sp-hybridized carbons at positions 3 and 4 of the original ring; NH₃ attacks either, giving a mix of 3- and 4-aminotoluenes.
